controls.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure policies, processes, procedures and practices related to the mapping, measuring and managing of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks are in place, transparent and implemented effectively.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies-Related Legal Requirements Definition
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify, understand, document and manage applicable statutory and regulatory requirements for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Trustworthy AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are designed to be reliable, safe, fair, secure, resilient, transparent, explainable and data privacy-enhanced to minimize emergent properties or unintended consequences.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Value Sustainment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to sustain the value of deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Situational Awareness of AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to develop and maintain an inventory of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) (internal and third-party).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Risk Mapping
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) in use and map those components to potential legal risks, including statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Internal Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document internal security, compliance and resilience for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Context Definition
AI & Autonomous Technologies Mission and Goals Definition
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define and document the organization's mission and defined goals for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Business Case
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to benchmark capabilities, targeted usage, goals and expected benefits and costs of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Potential Costs Analysis
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to assess potential costs, including non-monetary costs, resulting from expected or realized Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related errors or system functionality and trustworthiness.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Targeted Application Scope
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to specify and document the targeted application scope of the proposed use and operation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Training
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure personnel and external stakeholders are provided with position-specific risk management training for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Risk Management Decisions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to leverage decision makers from a diversity of demographics, disciplines, experience, expertise and backgrounds for mapping, measuring and managing Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Impact Assessment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to assess the impact(s) of proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) on individuals, groups, communities, organizations and society (e.g., Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA)).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Likelihood & Impact Risk Analysis
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define the potential likelihood and impact of each identified risk based on expected use and past uses of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) in similar contexts.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Continuous Improvements
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to continuously improve Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) capabilities to maximize benefits and minimize negative impacts associated with AAT.

controls.title: Assigned Responsibilities for AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to define and differentiate roles and responsibilities for:
(1) Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) configurations; and
(2) Oversight of AAT systems.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Risk Profiling
Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV) practices to enable Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related security, resilience and compliance-related conformity testing throughout the lifecycle of the AAT.

controls.title: AI TEVV Trustworthiness Assessment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to evaluate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) for trustworthy behavior and operation including security, anonymization and disaggregation of captured and stored data for approved purposes.

controls.title: AI TEVV Post-Deployment Monitoring
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to proactively and continuously monitor deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Updating AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to integrate continual improvements for deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Model Validation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to validate the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) model.

controls.title: Robust Stakeholder Engagement for AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel ongoing engagement with relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) stakeholders to encourage feedback about positive, negative and unanticipated impacts.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Feedback Integration
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to regularly collect, consider, prioritize and integrate risk-related feedback from those external to the team that developed or deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Ongoing Assessments
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct regular assessments of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) with independent assessors and stakeholders not involved in the development of the AAT.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies End User Feedback
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to collect and integrate feedback from end users and impacted communities into Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related system evaluation metrics.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Incident & Error Reporting
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to communicate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related incidents and/or errors to relevant stakeholders, including affected communities.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Intellectual Property Infringement Protections
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prevent third-party Intellectual Property (IP) rights infringement by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Data Source Identification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document data sources utilized in the training and/or operation of Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Diversity
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) stakeholder competencies, skills and capacities incorporate demographic diversity, broad domain and user experience expertise.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Competencies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related operator and practitioner proficiency requirements for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are defined, assessed and documented.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Requirements Definitions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to take socio-technical implications into account to address risks associated with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Implementation Tasks Definition
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define the tasks that Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) will support (e.g., classifiers, generative models, recommenders).

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Knowledge Limits
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document knowledge limits of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) to provide sufficient information to assist relevant stakeholder decision making.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Viability Decisions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define the criteria as to whether Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) achieved intended purposes and stated objectives to determine whether its development or deployment should proceed.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Negative Residual Risks
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document negative, residual risks (defined as the sum of all unmitigated risks) to both downstream acquirers and end users of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Responsibility To Supersede, Deactivate and/or Disengage AI & Autonomous Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define the criteria and responsible party(ies) for superseding, disengaging or deactivating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Production Monitoring
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor the functionality and behavior of the deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Unmeasurable AI & Autonomous Technologies Risks
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document unmeasurable risks or trustworthiness characteristics.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Environmental Impact & Sustainability
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to assess and document the environmental impacts and sustainability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).

controls.title: Previously Unknown AI & Autonomous Technologies Threats & Risks
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to respond to and recover from a previously unknown Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risk when it is identified.

controls.title: AI & Autonomous Technologies Risk Response
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prioritize, respond to and remediate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks based on assessments and other analytical output.

controls.title: Asset Governance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate an IT Asset Management (ITAM) program to implement and manage asset management controls.

controls.title: Asset-Service Dependencies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assess the security of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that support more than one critical business function.

controls.title: Stakeholder Identification & Involvement
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and involve pertinent stakeholders of critical Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) to support the ongoing secure management of those assets.

controls.title: Asset Inventories
Updates During Installations / Removals
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to update asset inventories as part of component installations, removals and asset upgrades.

controls.title:
Automated Location
Tracking
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to track the geographic location of system components.

controls.title: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to detect and alert upon the detection of unauthorized hardware, software and firmware components.

controls.title: Software Licensing Restrictions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect Intellectual Property (IP) rights with software licensing restrictions.

controls.title: Data Action Mapping
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to create and maintain a map of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) where sensitive/regulated data is stored, transmitted or processed.

controls.title: Configuration Management Database (CMDB)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement and manage a Configuration Management Database (CMDB), or similar technology, to monitor and govern technology asset-specific information.

controls.title: Asset Ownership Assignment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure asset ownership responsibilities are assigned, tracked and managed at a team, individual, or responsible organization level to establish a common understanding of requirements for asset protection.

controls.title: Accountability Information
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to include capturing the name, position and/or role of individuals responsible/accountable for administering assets as part of the technology asset inventory process.

controls.title: Provenance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to track the origin, development, ownership, location and changes to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).

controls.title: Network Diagrams & Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs)
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to maintain network architecture diagrams that: 
(1) Contain sufficient detail to assess the security of the network's architecture;
(2) Reflect the current architecture of the network environment; and
(3) Document all sensitive/regulated data flows.

controls.title: Asset Scope Classification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to determine security, compliance and resilience control applicability by identifying, assigning and documenting the appropriate asset scope categorization for all Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and personnel (internal and third-parties).

controls.title: Control Applicability Boundary Graphical Representation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure control applicability is appropriately-determined for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and third parties by graphically representing applicable boundaries.

controls.title: Compliance-Specific Asset Identification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to create and maintain a current inventory of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) that are in scope for statutory, regulatory and/or contractual compliance obligations that provides sufficient detail to determine control applicability, based on asset scope categorization.

controls.title: Security of Assets & Media
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain strict control over the internal or external distribution of any kind of sensitive/regulated media.

controls.title: Management Approval For External Media Transfer
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to obtain management approval for any sensitive/regulated media that is transferred outside of the organization's facilities.

controls.title: Unattended End-User Equipment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement enhanced protection measures for unattended technology assets to protect against tampering and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Kiosks & Point of Interaction (PoI) Devices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to appropriately protect devices that capture sensitive/regulated data via direct physical interaction from tampering and substitution.

controls.title: Physical Tampering Detection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to periodically inspect systems and system components for Indicators of Compromise (IoC).

controls.title: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of, destroy or repurpose system components using organization-defined techniques and methods to prevent information being recovered from these components.

controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that employees and third-party users return all organizational assets in their possession upon termination of employment, contract or agreement.

controls.title: Removal of Assets
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to authorize, control and track technology assets entering and exiting organizational facilities.

controls.title: Use of Personal Devices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the possession and/or use of personally-owned Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) within organization-controlled facilities.

controls.title: Logical Tampering Protection
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to assess the integrity of critical Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to detect evidence of tampering, where:
(1)	Logical assessments evaluate the integrity of critical components (e.g., configuration settings); and
(2)	Physical assessments evaluate assets for evidence of unauthorized access and/or modifications.

controls.title: Technology Asset Inspections
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to physically and logically inspect critical technology assets to detect evidence of tampering.

controls.title: Roots of Trust Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to provision and protect the confidentiality, integrity and authenticity of product supplier keys and data that can be used as a “roots of trust” basis for integrity verification.

controls.title: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of contingency planning controls to help ensure resilient Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (e.g., Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP) or Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) playbooks).

controls.title: Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to coordinate contingency plan development with internal and external elements responsible for related plans.

controls.title: Coordinate With External Service Providers
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to coordinate internal contingency plans with the contingency plans of external service providers to ensure that contingency requirements can be satisfied.

controls.title: Recovery Time / Point Objectives (RTO / RPO)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate recovery operations in accordance with Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

controls.title: Recovery Operations Criteria
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define specific criteria that must be met to initiate Business Continuity / Disaster Recover (BC/DR) plans that facilitate business continuity operations capable of meeting applicable Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

controls.title: Recovery Operations Communications
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to communicate the status of recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities to designated internal and external stakeholders.

controls.title: Identify Critical Assets
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document the critical Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) that support essential missions and business functions.

controls.title: Resume All Missions & Business Functions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to resume all missions and business functions within Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) of the contingency plan's activation.

controls.title: Continue Essential Mission & Business Functions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to continue essential missions and business functions with little or no loss of operational continuity and sustain that continuity until full system restoration at primary processing and/or storage sites.

controls.title: Resume Essential Missions & Business Functions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to resume essential missions and business functions within an organization-defined time period of contingency plan activation.

controls.title: Data Storage Location Reviews
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to perform periodic security reviews of storage locations that contain sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Simulated Events
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to incorporate simulated events into contingency training to facilitate effective response by personnel in crisis situations.

controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing & Exercises
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct tests and/or exercises to evaluate the contingency plan's effectiveness and the organization's readiness to execute the plan.

controls.title: Contingency Plan Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Lessons Learned
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and "lessons learned" activity every time the contingency plan is activated.

controls.title: Ongoing Contingency Planning
Alternative Security Measures
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement alternative or compensating controls to satisfy security functions when the primary means of implementing the security function is unavailable or compromised.

controls.title: Alternate Storage Site
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate storage site that includes both the assets and necessary agreements to permit the storage and recovery of system backup information.

controls.title: Separation from Primary Storage Site
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to separate the alternate storage site from the primary storage site to reduce susceptibility to similar threats.

controls.title: Primary Storage Site Accessibility
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and mitigate potential accessibility problems to the alternate storage sites in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster.

controls.title: Alternate Processing Site
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.

controls.title: Separation from Primary Processing Site
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to separate the alternate processing site from the primary processing site to reduce susceptibility to similar threats.

controls.title: Alternate Processing Site Accessibility
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and mitigate potential accessibility problems to the alternate processing sites and possible mitigation actions, in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster.

controls.title: Alternate Site Priority of Service
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to address priority-of-service provisions in alternate processing and storage sites that support availability requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs).

controls.title: Telecommunications Services Availability
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to reduce the likelihood of a single point of failure with primary telecommunications services.

controls.title: Telecommunications Priority of Service Provisions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to formalize primary and alternate telecommunications service agreements contain priority-of-service provisions that support availability requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs).

controls.title: Data Backups
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

controls.title: Testing for Reliability & Integrity
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to routinely test backups that verify the reliability of the backup process, as well as the integrity and availability of the data.

controls.title: Separate Storage for Critical Information
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to store backup copies of critical software and other security-related information in a separate facility or in a fire-rated container that is not collocated with the system being backed up.

controls.title: Recovery Images
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to reimage assets from configuration-controlled and integrity-protected images that represent a secure, operational state.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure and/or modification of backup information.

controls.title: Test Restoration Using Sampling
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize sampling of available backups to test recovery capabilities as part of business continuity plan testing.

controls.title: Transfer to Alternate Storage Site
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to transfer backup data to the alternate storage site at a rate that is capable of meeting both Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

controls.title: Redundant Secondary System
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain a failover capability, which is not collocated with the primary Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS), which can be activated with little-to-no loss of information or disruption to operations.

controls.title: Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) Recovery & Reconstitution
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure the secure recovery and reconstitution of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to a known state after a disruption, compromise or failure.

controls.title: Transaction Recovery
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize specialized backup mechanisms that will allow transaction recovery for transaction-based Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) in accordance with Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

controls.title: Failover Capability
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement real-time or near-real-time failover capability to maintain availability of critical Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).

controls.title: Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect backup and restoration hardware and software.

controls.title: Restoration Integrity Verification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to verify the integrity of backups and other restoration assets prior to using them for restoration.

controls.title: Capacity & Performance Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of capacity management controls to ensure optimal system performance to meet expected and anticipated future capacity requirements.

controls.title: Resource Priority
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to control resource utilization of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are susceptible to Denial of Service (DoS) attacks to limit and prioritize the use of resources.

controls.title: Capacity Planning
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications and environmental support will exist during contingency operations.

controls.title: Performance Monitoring
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to centrally-monitor and alert on the operating state and health status of critical Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

controls.title: Elastic Expansion
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to automatically scale the resources available for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), as demand conditions change.

controls.title: Configuration Management Program
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.

controls.title: Assignment of Responsibility
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement a segregation of duties for configuration management that prevents developers from performing production configuration management duties.

controls.title: Secure Baseline Configurations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards.

controls.title: Reviews & Updates
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to review and update baseline configurations:
(1) At least annually;
(2) When required due to so; or
(3) As part of system component installations and upgrades.

controls.title: Automated Central Management & Verification
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to govern and report on baseline configurations of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) through Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), or similar technologies.

controls.title: Development & Test Environment Configurations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to manage baseline configurations for development and test environments separately from operational baseline configurations to minimize the risk of unintentional changes.

controls.title: Configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) for High-Risk Areas
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) utilized in high-risk areas with more restrictive baseline configurations.

controls.title: Network Device Configuration File Synchronization
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure network devices to synchronize startup and running configuration files.

controls.title: Respond To Unauthorized Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to respond to unauthorized changes to configuration settings as security incidents.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.

controls.title: Periodic Review
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to periodically review system configurations to identify and disable unnecessary and/or non-secure functions, ports, protocols and services.

controls.title: Prevent Unauthorized Software Execution
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure systems to prevent the execution of unauthorized software programs.

controls.title: Split Tunneling
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prevent split tunneling for remote devices unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using organization-defined safeguards.

controls.title: Unsupported Internet Browsers & Email Clients
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to allow only approved Internet browsers and email clients to run on systems.

controls.title: User-Installed Software
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the ability of non-privileged users to install unauthorized software.

controls.title: Unauthorized Installation Alerts
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure systems to generate an alert when the unauthorized installation of software is detected.

controls.title: Restrict Roles Permitted To Install Software
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure systems to prevent the installation of software, unless the action is performed by a privileged user or service.

controls.title: Sensitive / Regulated Data Access Enforcement
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to restrict access to sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Sensitive / Regulated Data Actions
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to generate event logs whenever sensitive/regulated data is collected, created, updated, deleted and/or archived.

controls.title: Change Management Program
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of a change management program.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the technical configuration change control processes.

controls.title: Prohibition Of Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prohibit unauthorized changes, unless organization-approved change requests are received.

controls.title: Test, Validate & Document Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to appropriately test and document proposed changes in a non-production environment before changes are implemented in a production environment.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Representative for Asset Lifecycle Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to include a cybersecurity and/or data protection representative in the configuration change control review process.

controls.title: Automated Security Response
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to implement remediation actions upon the detection of unauthorized baseline configurations change(s).

controls.title: Security Impact Analysis for Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to analyze proposed changes for potential security impacts, prior to the implementation of the change.

controls.title: Access Restriction For Change
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce configuration restrictions in an effort to restrict the ability of users to conduct unauthorized changes.

controls.title: Automated Access Enforcement / Auditing
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to perform after-the-fact reviews of configuration change logs to discover any unauthorized changes.

controls.title: Permissions To Implement Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to limit operational privileges for implementing changes.

controls.title: Stakeholder Notification of Changes
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure stakeholders are made aware of and understand the impact of proposed changes.

controls.title: Control Functionality Verification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to verify the functionality of security, compliance and resilience controls following implemented changes to ensure applicable controls operate as designed.

controls.title: Report Verification Results
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to report the results of security, compliance and resilience capability verification to appropriate organizational management.

controls.title: Cloud Services
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cloud management controls to ensure cloud instances are secure and in-line with industry practices.

controls.title: Cloud Security Architecture
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure the cloud security architecture supports the organization's technology strategy to securely design, configure and maintain cloud employments.

controls.title: Application Programming Interface (API) Security
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure support for secure interoperability between components with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

controls.title: Multi-Tenant Environments
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure multi-tenant owned or managed assets (physical and virtual) are designed and governed such that provider and customer (tenant) user access is appropriately segmented from other tenant users.

controls.title: Customer Responsibility Matrix (CRM)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to formally document a Customer Responsibility Matrix (CRM), delineating assigned responsibilities for security, compliance and resilience controls between the Cloud Service Provider (CSP) and its customers.

controls.title: Multi-Tenant Event Logging Capabilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Multi-Tenant Service Providers (MTSP) facilitate security event logging capabilities for its customers that are consistent with applicable statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations.

controls.title: Multi-Tenant Forensics Capabilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Multi-Tenant Service Providers (MTSP) facilitate prompt forensic investigations in the event of a suspected or confirmed security incident.

controls.title: Multi-Tenant Incident Response Capabilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Multi-Tenant Service Providers (MTSP) facilitate prompt response to suspected or confirmed security incidents and vulnerabilities, including timely notification to affected customers.

controls.title: Geolocation Requirements for Processing, Storage and Service Locations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to control the location of cloud processing/storage based on business requirements that includes statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.

controls.title: Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), or similar technology, to provide boundary protection and monitoring functions that both provide access to the cloud and protect the organization from misuse of cloud resources.

controls.title: Side Channel Attack Prevention
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prevent "side channel attacks" when using a Content Delivery Network (CDN) by restricting access to the origin server's IP address to the CDN and an authorized management network.

controls.title: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the identification and implementation of relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual controls.

controls.title: Non-Compliance Oversight
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to document and review instances of non-compliance with statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations to develop appropriate risk mitigation actions.

controls.title: Compliance Scope
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to document and validate the scope of security, compliance and resilience controls that are determined to meet statutory, regulatory and/or contractual compliance obligations.

controls.title: Ability To Demonstrate Conformity
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure the organization is able to demonstrate security, compliance and/or resilience capability conformity with applicable cybersecurity and data protection laws, regulations and/or contractual obligations.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Controls Oversight
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to provide a security, compliance and resilience controls oversight function that reports to the organization's executive leadership.

controls.title: Internal Audit Function
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement an internal audit function that is capable of providing senior organization management with insights into the appropriateness of the organization's technology and information governance processes.

controls.title: Periodic Audits
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct periodic audits of security, compliance and resilience controls to evaluate conformity with the organization's documented policies, standards and procedures.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Assessments
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to regularly review processes and documented procedures to ensure conformity with the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.

controls.title: Independent Assessors
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize independent assessors to evaluate security, compliance and resilience at planned intervals or when the Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) undergoes significant changes.

controls.title: Functional Review Of Security, Compliance & Resilience Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to regularly review Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) for adherence to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies and standards.

controls.title: Audit Activities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to thoughtfully plan audits by including input from operational risk and compliance partners to minimize the impact of audit-related activities on business operations.

controls.title: Use of Cryptographic Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.

controls.title: Alternate Physical Protection
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information as an alternative to physical safeguards.

controls.title: Export-Controlled Cryptography
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to address the exporting of cryptographic technologies in compliance with relevant statutory and regulatory requirements.

controls.title: Cryptographic Cipher Suites and Protocols Inventory
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify, document and review deployed cryptographic cipher suites and protocols to proactively respond to industry trends regarding the continued viability of utilized cryptographic cipher suites and protocols.

controls.title: Automated Authentication Through Cryptographic Modules
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to enable systems to authenticate to a cryptographic module.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality of data being transmitted.

controls.title: Transmission Integrity
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the integrity of data being transmitted.

controls.title: Encrypting Data At Rest
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.

controls.title: Storage Media
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive/regulated data residing on storage media.

controls.title: Non-Console Administrative Access
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of non-console administrative access.

controls.title: Wireless Access Authentication & Encryption
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of wireless networking technologies by implementing authentication and strong encryption.

controls.title: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to securely implement an internal Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) infrastructure or obtain PKI services from a reputable PKI service provider.

controls.title: Availability
controls.description: Resiliency mechanisms exist to ensure the availability of data in the event of the loss of cryptographic keys.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.

controls.title: Symmetric Keys
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the production and management of symmetric cryptographic keys using Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS)-compliant key management technology and processes.

controls.title: Asymmetric Keys
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the production and management of asymmetric cryptographic keys using Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS)-compliant key management technology and processes that protect the user’s private key.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Loss or Change
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure the availability of information in the event of the loss of cryptographic keys by individual users.

controls.title: Control & Distribution of Cryptographic Keys
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the secure distribution of symmetric and asymmetric cryptographic keys using industry recognized key management technology and processes.

controls.title: Third-Party Cryptographic Keys
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure customers are provided with appropriate key management guidance whenever cryptographic keys are shared.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.

controls.title: Data Stewardship
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data stewardship is assigned, documented and communicated.

controls.title: Sensitive / Regulated Data Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect sensitive/regulated data wherever it is processed and/or stored.

controls.title: Sensitive / Regulated Media Records
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure media records for sensitive/regulated data contain sufficient information to determine the potential impact in the event of a data loss incident.

controls.title: Defining Access Authorizations for Sensitive / Regulated Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to explicitly define authorizations for specific individuals and/or roles for logical and /or physical access to sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Data & Asset Classification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.

controls.title: Media Access
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to control and restrict access to digital and non-digital media to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Disclosure of Information
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the disclosure of sensitive/regulated data to authorized parties with a need to know.

controls.title: Masking Displayed Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to apply data masking to sensitive/regulated information that is displayed or printed.

controls.title: Media Marking
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to mark media in accordance with data protection requirements so that personnel are alerted to distribution limitations, handling caveats and applicable security requirements.

controls.title: Media Storage
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to: 
(1) Physically control and securely store digital and non-digital media within controlled areas using organization-defined security measures; and
(2) Protect system media until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques and procedures.

controls.title: Physically Secure All Media
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to physically secure all media that contains sensitive information.

controls.title: Sensitive Data Inventories
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain inventory logs of all sensitive media and conduct sensitive media inventories at least annually.

controls.title: Periodic Scans for Sensitive / Regulated Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to periodically scan unstructured data sources for sensitive/regulated data or data requiring special protection measures by statutory, regulatory or contractual obligations.

controls.title: Making Sensitive Data Unreadable In Storage
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure sensitive/regulated data is rendered human unreadable anywhere sensitive/regulated data is stored.

controls.title: Storing Authentication Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prohibit the storage of sensitive transaction authentication data after authorization.

controls.title: Media Transportation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect and control digital and non-digital media during transport outside of controlled areas using appropriate security measures.

controls.title: Custodians
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify custodians throughout the transport of digital or non-digital media.

controls.title: Encrypting Data In Storage Media
controls.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of information stored on digital media during transport outside of controlled areas.

controls.title: Physical Media Disposal
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of media when it is no longer required, using formal procedures.

controls.title: System Media Sanitization
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize system media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.

controls.title: System Media Sanitization Documentation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to supervise, track, document and verify system media sanitization and disposal actions.

controls.title: Sanitization of Personal Data (PD)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the sanitization of Personal Data (PD).

controls.title: Media Use
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the use of types of digital media on systems or system components.

controls.title: Limitations on Use
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the use and distribution of sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Data Reclassification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to reclassify data, including associated Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), commensurate with the security category and/or classification level of the information.

controls.title: Removable Media Security
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict removable media in accordance with data handling and acceptable usage parameters.

controls.title: Use of External Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern how external parties, including Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), are used to securely store, process and transmit data.

controls.title: Limits of Authorized Use
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to prohibit external parties, including Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), from storing, processing and transmitting data unless authorized individuals first: 
(1) Verifying the implementation of required security, compliance and/or resilience controls; or
(2) Retaining a processing agreement with the entity hosting the external TAAS.

controls.title: Portable Storage Devices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict or prohibit the use of portable storage devices by users on external systems.

controls.title: Information Sharing
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a process to assist users in making information sharing decisions to ensure data is appropriately protected.

controls.title: Publicly Accessible Content
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to control publicly-accessible content.

controls.title: Ad-Hoc Transfers
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to secure ad-hoc exchanges of large digital files with internal or external parties.

controls.title: Media & Data Retention
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to retain media and data in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.

controls.title: Geographic Location of Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to inventory, document and maintain data flows for data that is resident (permanently or temporarily) within a service's geographically distributed applications (physical and virtual), infrastructure, systems components and/or shared with other third-parties.

controls.title: Information Disposal
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of, destroy or erase information.

controls.title: Data Quality Operations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to check for Redundant, Obsolete/Outdated, Toxic or Trivial (ROTT) data to ensure the accuracy, relevance, timeliness, impact, completeness and de-identification of information throughout the information lifecycle.

controls.title: Updating & Correcting Personal Data (PD)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize technical controls to correct Personal Data (PD) that is inaccurate or outdated, incorrectly determined regarding impact, or incorrectly de-identified.

controls.title: De-Identification (Anonymization)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to anonymize data by removing Personal Data (PD) from datasets.

controls.title: Removal, Masking, Encryption, Hashing or Replacement of Direct Identifiers
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to remove, mask, encrypt, hash or replace direct identifiers in a dataset.

controls.title: Information Location
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document the location of information and the specific system components on which the information resides.

controls.title: Transfer of Sensitive and/or Regulated Data
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict and govern the transfer of sensitive and/or regulated data to third-countries or international organizations.

controls.title: Endpoint Device Management (EDM)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of Endpoint Device Management (EDM) controls.

controls.title: Endpoint Protection Measures
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality, integrity, availability and safety of endpoint devices.

controls.title: Prohibit Installation Without Privileged Status
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to prohibit software installations without explicitly assigned privileged status.

controls.title: Software Installation Alerts
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to generate an alert when new software is detected.

controls.title: Governing Access Restriction for Change
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection (Anti-Malware)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code.

controls.title: Automatic Antimalware Signature Updates
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to update antimalware technologies, including signature definitions.

controls.title: Documented Protection Measures
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to document antimalware technologies.

controls.title: Centralized Management of Antimalware Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to centrally-manage antimalware technologies.

controls.title: Evolving Malware Threats
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to perform periodic evaluations evolving malware threats to assess systems that are generally not considered to be commonly affected by malicious software.

controls.title: Always On Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that anti-malware technologies are continuously running in real-time and cannot be disabled or altered by non-privileged users, unless specifically authorized by management on a case-by-case basis for a limited time period.

controls.title: Software Firewall
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize host-based firewall software, or a similar technology, on all endpoint devices, where technically feasible.

controls.title: Endpoint File Integrity Monitoring (FIM)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize File Integrity Monitor (FIM), or similar technologies, to detect and report on unauthorized changes to selected files and configuration settings.

controls.title: Integrity Checks
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to validate configurations through integrity checking of software and firmware.

controls.title: Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to detect and respond to unauthorized configuration changes as cybersecurity incidents.

controls.title: Host Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (HIDS / HIPS)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize Host-based Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (HIDS / HIPS), or similar technologies, to monitor for and protect against anomalous host activity, including lateral movement across the network.

controls.title: Phishing & Spam Protection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize anti-phishing and spam protection technologies to detect and take action on unsolicited messages transported by electronic mail.

controls.title: Trusted Path
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish a trusted communications path between the user and the security functions of the operating system.

controls.title: Restrict Access To Security Functions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure security functions are restricted to authorized individuals and enforce least privilege control requirements for necessary job functions.

controls.title: Host-Based Security Function Isolation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement underlying software separation mechanisms to facilitate security function isolation.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of security, compliance and resilience governance controls.

controls.title: Steering Committee & Program Oversight
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to align security, compliance and resilience capabilities with business requirements through a steering committee or advisory board, comprised of key cybersecurity, data protection and business executives, which meets formally and on a regular basis.

controls.title: Status Reporting To Governing Body
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to provide governance oversight reporting and recommendations to those entrusted to make executive decisions about matters considered material to the organization's Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).

controls.title: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish, maintain and disseminate policies, standards and procedures necessary for secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.

controls.title: Exception Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to prohibit exceptions to standards, except when the exception has been formally assessed for risk impact, approved and recorded.

controls.title: Periodic Review & Update of Security, Compliance & Resilience Program
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to review the Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP), including policies, standards and procedures, at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.title: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to assign one or more qualified individuals with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).

controls.title: Stakeholder Accountability Structure
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce an accountability structure so that appropriate teams and individuals are empowered, responsible and trained for mapping, measuring and managing Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD)-related risks.

controls.title: Authoritative Chain of Command
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an authoritative chain of command with clear lines of communication to remove ambiguity from individuals and teams related to managing Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD)-related risks.

controls.title: Measures of Performance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, report and monitor Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) measures of performance.

controls.title: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, report and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assist organizational management in performance monitoring and trend analysis of the Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).

controls.title: Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, report and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to assist senior management in performance monitoring and trend analysis of the Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).

controls.title: Contacts With Authorities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and document appropriate contacts with relevant law enforcement and regulatory bodies.

controls.title: Contacts With Groups & Associations
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to establish contact with selected groups and associations within the security, compliance and resilience communities to: 
(1) Facilitate ongoing cybersecurity and data protection education and training for organizational personnel;
(2) Maintain currency with recommended cybersecurity and data protection practices, techniques and technologies; and
(3) Share current cybersecurity and/or data protection-related information including threats, vulnerabilities and incidents.

controls.title: Defining Business Context & Mission
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define the context of its business model and document the organization's mission.

controls.title: Define Control Objectives
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish control objectives as the basis for the selection, implementation and management of the organization's internal security, compliance and resilience control system.

controls.title: Data Governance
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate data governance to oversee the organization's policies, standards and procedures so that sensitive/regulated data is effectively managed and maintained in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.

controls.title: Purpose Validation
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor mission/business-critical Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to ensure those resources are being used consistent with their intended purpose.

controls.title: Business As Usual (BAU) Security, Compliance & Resilience Practices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to incorporate security, compliance and resilience principles into Business As Usual (BAU) practices through executive leadership involvement.

controls.title: Operationalizing Security, Compliance & Resilience Capabilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to operationalize security, compliance and resilience practices for each Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) under their control.

controls.title: Select Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to select required security, compliance and resilience controls for each Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) under their control.

controls.title: Implement Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to implement required security, compliance and resilience controls for each Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) under their control.

controls.title: Assess Controls
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to assess if required security, compliance and resilience controls for each Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) under their control are:
(1) Implemented correctly; and 
(2) Operating as intended.

controls.title: Authorize Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to obtain authorization for the production use of each Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) under their control.

controls.title: Monitor Controls
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to compel data and/or process owners to monitor Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) under their control on an ongoing basis for applicable threats and risks, as well as to ensure security, compliance and resilience controls are operating as intended.

controls.title: Materiality Determination
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define materiality threshold criteria capable of designating an incident as material.

controls.title: Material Risks
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define criteria necessary to designate a risk as a material risk.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Status Reporting
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to submit status reporting of the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience program to applicable statutory and/or regulatory authorities, as required.

controls.title: Human Resources Security Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of personnel security controls.

controls.title: Position Categorization
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to manage personnel security risk by assigning a risk designation to all positions and establishing screening criteria for individuals filling those positions.

controls.title: Users With Elevated Privileges
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that every user accessing Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that process, store and/or transmit sensitive/regulated data is cleared and regularly trained to handle the information in question.

controls.title: Probationary Periods
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify newly onboarded personnel for enhanced monitoring during their probationary period.

controls.title: Defined Roles & Responsibilities
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define cybersecurity roles & responsibilities for all personnel.

controls.title: User Awareness
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to communicate with users about their roles and responsibilities to maintain a safe and secure working environment.

controls.title: Competency Requirements for Security-Related Positions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that all security-related positions are staffed by qualified individuals who have the necessary skill set.

controls.title: Personnel Screening
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to manage personnel security risk by screening individuals prior to authorizing access.

controls.title: Roles With Special Protection Measures
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that individuals accessing a system that stores, transmits or processes information requiring special protection satisfy organization-defined personnel screening criteria.

controls.title: Formal Indoctrination
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to formally educate authorized users on proper data handling practices for all the relevant types of data to which they have access.

controls.title: Terms of Employment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to require all employees and contractors to apply cybersecurity and data protection principles in their daily work to enable secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.

controls.title: Rules of Behavior
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define acceptable and unacceptable rules of behavior for the use of technologies, including consequences for unacceptable behavior.

controls.title: Social Media & Social Networking Restrictions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to define rules of behavior that contain explicit restrictions on the use of social media and networking sites, posting information on commercial websites and sharing account information.

controls.title: Technology Use Restrictions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to establish usage restrictions and implementation guidance for organizational technologies based on the potential to cause damage to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), if used maliciously.

controls.title: Use of Critical Technologies
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern usage policies for critical technologies.

controls.title: Use of Mobile Devices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to manage business risks associated with permitting mobile device access to organizational resources.

controls.title: Policy Familiarization & Acknowledgement
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure personnel receive recurring familiarization with the organization's security, compliance and resilience policies and provide acknowledgement.

controls.title: Access Agreements
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to require internal and third-party users to sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access.

controls.title: Confidentiality Agreements
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to require Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) or similar confidentiality agreements that reflect the needs to protect data and operational details, or both employees and third-parties.

controls.title: Personnel Sanctions
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to sanction personnel failing to comply with established security policies, standards and procedures.

controls.title: Workplace Investigations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct employee misconduct investigations when there is reasonable assurance that a policy has been violated.

controls.title: Personnel Transfer
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to adjust logical and physical access authorizations to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and facilities upon personnel reassignment or transfer, in a timely manner.

controls.title: Personnel Termination
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the termination of individual employment.

controls.title: Asset Collection
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to retrieve organization-owned assets upon termination of an individual's employment.

controls.title: High-Risk Terminations
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to expedite the process of removing "high risk" individual’s access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) upon termination, as determined by management.

controls.title: Post-Employment Requirements Notification
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern former employee behavior by formally notifying terminated individuals of their applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for the protection of sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Third-Party Personnel
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern third-party personnel by reviewing and monitoring third-party security, compliance and/or resilience roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Separation of Duties (SoD)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement and maintain Separation of Duties (SoD) to prevent potential inappropriate activity without collusion.

controls.title: Incompatible Roles
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to avoid incompatible development-specific roles through limiting and reviewing developer privileges to change hardware, software and firmware components within a production/operational environment.

controls.title: Identify Critical Skills & Gaps
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to evaluate the critical security, compliance and resilience skills needed to support the organization's mission and identify gaps that exist.

controls.title: Perform Succession Planning
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to perform succession planning for vital security, compliance and resilience roles.

controls.title: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of identification and access management controls.

controls.title: Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to strictly govern the use of Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) solutions, both on-premises and those hosted by an External Service Provider (ESP).

controls.title: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users.

controls.title: Group Authentication
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to require individuals to be authenticated with an individual authenticator when a group authenticator is utilized.

controls.title: Replay-Resistant Authentication
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to employ replay-resistant authentication.

controls.title: Identification & Authentication for Non-Organizational Users
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) third-party users and processes that provide services to the organization.

controls.title: Acceptance of Third-Party Credentials
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to accept Federal Identity, Credential and Access Management (FICAM)-approved third-party credentials.

controls.title: Acceptance of External Authenticators
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict the use of external authenticators to those that are National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)-compliant and maintain a list of accepted external authenticators.

controls.title: Identification & Authentication for Devices
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) devices before establishing a connection using bidirectional authentication that is cryptographically- based and replay resistant.

controls.title: Identification & Authentication for Third-Party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and authenticate third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

controls.title: Sharing Identification & Authentication Information
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure external service providers provide current and accurate information for any third-party user with access to the organization's data or assets.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
(1) Remote network access; 
(2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
(3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process sensitive/regulated data.

controls.title: Network Access to Privileged Accounts
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate network access for privileged accounts.

controls.title: Network Access to Non-Privileged Accounts
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate network access for non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Local Access to Privileged Accounts
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts.

controls.title: Out-of-Band Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for access to privileged and non-privileged accounts such that one of the factors is independently provided by a device separate from the system being accessed.

controls.title: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a formal user registration and de-registration process that governs the assignment of access rights.

controls.title: Change of Roles & Duties
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to revoke user access rights following changes in personnel roles and duties, if no longer necessary or permitted.

controls.title: Termination of Employment
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to revoke user access rights in a timely manner, upon termination of employment or contract.

controls.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) to restrict access to individuals assigned specific roles with legitimate business needs.

controls.title: Identifier Management (User Names)
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to govern naming standards for usernames and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

controls.title: User Identity (ID) Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure proper user identification management for non-consumer users and administrators.

controls.title: Cross-Organization Management
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to coordinate username identifiers with external organizations for cross-organization management of identifiers.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Securely manage authenticators for users and devices; and
(2) Ensure the strength of authentication is appropriate to the classification of the data being accessed.

controls.title: Password-Based Authentication
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce complexity, length and lifespan considerations to ensure strong criteria for password-based authentication.

controls.title: Password Managers
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect and store passwords via a password manager tool.

controls.title: PKI-Based Authentication
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to validate certificates by constructing and verifying a certification path to an accepted trust anchor including checking certificate status information for PKI-based authentication.

controls.title: Protection of Authenticators
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to protect authenticators commensurate with the sensitivity of the information to which use of the authenticator permits access.

controls.title: No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that unencrypted, static authenticators are not embedded in applications, scripts or stored on function keys.

controls.title: Hardware Token-Based Authentication
controls.description: Automated mechanisms exist to ensure organization-defined token quality requirements are satisfied for hardware token-based authentication.

controls.title: Default Authenticators
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure default authenticators are changed as part of account creation or system installation.

controls.title: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure cryptographic modules adhere to applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements for security strength.

controls.title: Adaptive Identification & Authentication
